info.title: omni-one
info.description: Omni-One Seller OS — offline $0 daily close, briefing, scenarios, vision OCR, analytics. Generated snapshot for SDK codegen. All money endpoints cite [file:line]. See docs/handbook 01-05. Servers: local :5003, docker :5003. Auth: X-API-Key optional (fail-closed on admin). Counters in-process; Prometheus scrapes /metrics. Golden demo true_profit $169.09 margin 61.7% at-risk $102.75 3 msgs 1 reorder 0 leaks.

post.summary: DAILY CLOSE: profit + reorder/PO + reply drafts + leaks ($0)
post.description: Runs the 5-minute morning ritual offline. Accepts demo=true (synthetic shop, seed 42) or folder=path. Returns CloseBundle JSON with kpis, reorder sheet, reply queue, leaks, po draft, ingest_report. Golden demo: true_profit $169.09, margin 61.7%. All numbers cite [file:line]. Citation rule: no citation, no action. The close refuses to invent tasks. Offline $0. See docs/handbook/01-morning-routine.md daily ritual, 02-supplier-playbook.md cover policy 14d, 03-reply-playbook.md P0<2h, 04-accountant-pack.md invariant true_profit<=gmv, 05-incidents.md S1<1h. Demo seed default 42. Shop default 'our shop'. All money USD 2dp.

KPIs.title: KPIs
KPIs.description: Ledger KPIs from close.csv Section A. Invariant true_profit<=gmv always (evals assert). Golden demo true_profit 169.09.

gmv.description: Gross merchandise value: sum order-row totals. Source shopify_orders.csv etc.
